1.en_consolidated_definition: Skiboarding: A winter sport practiced on a board 80 to 120 centimeters in length. This term is an anglicism and relatively uncommon. In this context, skiboard enthusiasts perform acrobatic jumps and hazardous maneuvers similar to those of skateboarders on U-shaped ramps.
